parent_objective: design a stronger non-oracle pre-emergency stimulus after passive figure-eight produced reset-only outcome evidence
blocked_by: M1406 blocks training/export from reset-only M1405 evidence and requires a new stimulus axis
supersedes: repeating the same figure-eight source/outcome grid
training from M1405 reset-only accepted rows

public_gates: M1407 must design a non-oracle pre-emergency gate/corridor stimulus before implementation
M1407 must preserve the P0 human-view no-privileged actor input contract
M1407 must specify source reconstruction, outcome criteria, and history intervention controls
M1407 must not train, run PPO, run a source sweep, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run a source sweep
do not add actor oracle labels
do not add scripted controller commands
do not claim self-identification from design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a stronger non-oracle warmup stimulus after passive figure-eight gives near-boundary but not history-positive outcomes
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: task/source design only; no implementation, source smoke, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design requires actor oracle labels
stop if the design requires scripted control commands
stop if the design changes actor input dimensionality or semantics
stop if source reconstruction and outcome criteria are omitted
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if no non-oracle stimulus is feasible
route to simulator/task API extension design if existing env cannot represent the stimulus
route to boundary-conditioned config redesign if multi-stage geometry is unnecessary

admission_evidence: M1405 improves preferred near-boundary candidates to 26 but finds 0 warmup-history-positive rows
M1406 audits M1405 as reset-only and blocks training/export
M1406 selects a stronger non-oracle stimulus axis before another source smoke
blocked_shortcuts: do not run source smoke before design
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: source and outcome pass/fail criteria are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1407 must design controls to prevent current/recent observations from replacing warmup-history evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Task/source design following M1406 reset-only audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no non-oracle pre-emergency stimulus can be designed, record the blocker and route to branch synthesis before training.
allowed_claims: no implementation, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A non-oracle pre-emergency gate/corridor stimulus design can create stronger command-response evidence than passive figure-eight curvature without changing actor inputs.
success_criteria: design specifies stimulus geometry, actor-contract guardrails, source reconstruction metrics, outcome criteria, intervention controls, and next implementation route
design does not route directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design requires scripted control commands or actor oracle labels
design changes actor input dimensionality or semantics
design omits source or outcome criteria
design routes directly to training or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1407 passes if it designs a non-oracle pre-emergency stimulus route before implementation or training.
